mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_WLT_CHARGE_L (wallet_id, payment_method_id, idempotency_key, amount, order_id) VALUES (#{walletId}, #{paymentMethodId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{amount}, #{orderId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, wallet_id, payment_method_id, idempotency_key, amount, status, failure_reason, order_id, payment_key, created_at, updated_at FROM T_WLT_CHARGE_L WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE T_WLT_CHARGE_L SET status = 'PROCESSING', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE T_WLT_CHARGE_L SET status = 'FAILED', failure_reason = #{failureReason}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status <> 'SUCCESS'
UPDATE T_WLT_CHARGE_L SET status = 'PENDING', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
